notes:
Sales notes / POC summary:
- Product: in-editor copilot for small/medium engineering teams; tight latency = core differentiator.
- Primary ask: sub-100ms time-to-first-token (TTFT) for single-line completions, 80-120ms acceptable depending on region. Jitter target: <20ms p95.
- Throughput: 75 concurrent active devs in team sessions; expected peak steady throughput ~120 req/s across workspace routing. Burst tolerance required for org-wide events.
- Token budget model: prefer per-session token budget (128 tokens default) with server-side throttling + graceful backpressure. Need SDK hooks to expose token usage and to preemptively trim continuation length.
- Streaming: chunk size 8-16 tokens, prefer continuous stream with fast first chunk (TTFT optimization). Careful about rebuffering/jitter — UX sensitive to pauses >50ms.
- Backpressure strategy: want queue depth + latency SLO-based rejection (fast 429) rather than long tail queueing; automatic fallback to smaller/quantized model when latency SLO breached.
- Model/version pinning: must pin to model id per-release channel (stable/dev/nightly) and ability to rollback to previous pinned version in <5 mins. Also want compatibility matrix for quantized variants.
- KV cache warmup: prefetch common repo prefixes on file open to reduce cold-start for completions. Cache affinity to developer workspace important.
- Cost sensitivity: evaluating dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted with committed spend. Expect cost per monthly active dev to be key metric.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, org-level audit logs, KMS integration for workspace keys, retention policy configurable per-team. Data residency: US and EU options required.
- Quote from CTO on call: "If TTFT fluctuates, devs stop trusting inline suggestions — that kills retention."
- Links: perf artifacts in Drive; call transcripts linked (fireflies).
- Current impression: product/ux team excited; infra team cautious until can see repeatable p95 TTFT under load.
- Next: SE to provide updated canary with batching/backpressure knobs + cost model by 2026-03-07. Legal to receive DPA draft by 2026-03-05.
